title: Variant Bank / Zero-Time Commitment Repair
principle: ZERO-TIME VARIANT SELECTION DOES NOT MEAN ZERO BODY CONSEQUENCE. Select configuration outside BODY_CLOCK; once a branch is committed, its load/support/cadence/silhouette consequences must be authored and visibly different.

timing_classes.TWOS: one key held two display frames
timing_classes.FOURS: one key held four display frames

rig_schema.reference: integer ASCII-grid control points; independently authored generic rig; no source contours

BODY_CLOCK.rule: Only authored causal body-state changes consume body timing.

CONFIG_AXIS.rule: BANK_SELECT consumes zero BODY_CLOCK ticks and creates no full-body key by itself.

variant_bank.visible_test: Both compilations share the exact same precommit body keys. The branch selector adds no body-time sample. A/B divergence becomes visible only when commitment changes support, silhouette, cadence, overshoot, lag, and recovery.

keys.name: OFFSET_READY
keys.support_contact: Both feet grounded; left hip slightly heavier
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root tall at x24; chest/head already biased right so the starting silhouette is not bilateral
keys.causal_role: establish asymmetrical neutral with room to choose either branch

keys.name: QUERY_TILT
keys.support_contact: Both feet grounded; left support loads while right side opens
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root drifts one cell left/downstream while chest tilts farther left; right arm opens as counterweight
keys.causal_role: readable pre-choice inquiry; upper body asks before the lower body commits

keys.name: DEEP_PRECOMMIT_COIL
keys.support_contact: Both feet grounded; left leg deeply loaded, right foot still trusted
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root sinks/backs left; chest counter-rotates against both possible branch directions; no branch-specific body key yet
keys.causal_role: store energy before zero-time bank selection

keys.name: LOW_RIGHT_COMMIT_SPIKE
keys.support_contact: Left foot bears launch load; right foot clears
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root rises/advances; chest snaps right while left support stays behind the COM
keys.causal_role: variant A commitment event: selection earns body consequence only here

keys.name: LOW_CROSS_ACCEL
keys.support_contact: Left foot remains last support; right leg reaches ahead
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root arcs right/up and outruns the trailing support; chest leads while both arms lag on different arcs
keys.causal_role: accelerating branch travel with distinct low-forward silhouette

keys.name: RIGHT_PLANT_CATCH
keys.support_contact: Right foot acquires ground ahead of COM; left foot trails clear
keys.motion_arc_root_note: right foot contact occurs in front of root; torso remains ahead of stable pelvis
keys.causal_role: hard support join; first catch does not erase velocity debt

keys.name: DEEP_ABSORB
keys.support_contact: Right foot load-bearing; left foot still trailing
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root continues past plant then sinks; chest/head recoil left as forward debt compresses into the right leg
keys.causal_role: make the catch heavy by holding crumple and torso lag

keys.name: TORSO_OVERSHOOT
keys.support_contact: Right foot still owns support; left remains trailing
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root decelerates/backtracks one cell while chest/head swing past it to the right
keys.causal_role: overshoot after compression; upper chain passes the pelvis instead of reverse-interpolating

keys.name: SECOND_SUPPORT_REACQUIRE
keys.support_contact: Both feet grounded; right remains primary while left finally catches up
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root lifts one row; torso remains forward/right, leaving visible recovery debt
keys.causal_role: reacquire broad support after overshoot without pretending recovery is complete

keys.name: NEW_READY_WITH_DEBT
keys.support_contact: Both feet stable; stance wider and right-biased relative to start
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root stays x29 rather than returning x24; rightward bias and asymmetrical arms preserve consequence
keys.causal_role: settle into a new address, not an idle reset

keys.name: HIGH_LEFT_COMMIT_SPIKE
keys.support_contact: Right foot bears launch load; left foot clears
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root shifts left while chest/head rise and open left; right support drives under the pelvis
keys.causal_role: variant B commitment: a slower loaded release with opposite support owner

keys.name: HIGH_LEFT_WHIP
keys.support_contact: Right foot remains last support; left side cuts upward/left
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root lifts/advances left while head and leading arm arc above it; trailing hand remains low
keys.causal_role: one-frame high whip after loaded commit

keys.name: LEFT_PLANT_CATCH
keys.support_contact: Left foot acquires ground; right foot trails clear
keys.motion_arc_root_note: left foot plants ahead of root; chest is still rotated away from the catch direction
keys.causal_role: opposite-side catch converts high whip into torsional debt

keys.name: TORSION_BANK_HOLD
keys.support_contact: Left foot load-bearing; right foot trailing
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root stays low/left while chest/head swing right and high; right arm becomes a delayed counter-chain
keys.causal_role: hold a twisted aftermath so branch B cannot read as branch A mirrored

keys.name: ARM_LAG_SNAPBACK
keys.support_contact: Left foot still owns support; right foot remains behind
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root barely advances; chest recenters while right arm remains late and low, then begins its own return
keys.causal_role: secondary lag pays after torso has already started decelerating

keys.name: BROAD_SUPPORT_RECOVERY_DEBT
keys.support_contact: Both feet grounded; left remains primary with right newly reacquired
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root rises and drifts right one cell, but chest remains left of root and arms disagree, preserving debt
keys.causal_role: longer recovery hold than A branch; cadence itself becomes branch information

keys.name: NEW_READY_BACKWEIGHTED
keys.support_contact: Both feet stable; final stance remains left/back-weighted and narrower than A
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root remains x19 rather than x24; chest/head drift right while lower support stays left-biased
keys.causal_role: settle at a different address/attitude; no return to common idle

compile.connective_motion: Deterministic authored quadratic arcs only between keys with unchanged support/contact topology; support changes snap at decisive keys.

compatibility.uapl_uat_boundary: ASCII decisive keys are semantic authority; CONFIG_AXIS selection is non-temporal; timing is explicit authored compilation opinion.

revision.repair_strategy: Preserve zero-time configuration selection but replace metadata-only behavior with two visibly distinct committed body performances and nonuniform cadence.

actual_render_inspection.method: Exact authoritative 83-frame H.264 candidate decoded and inspected as a complete frame sheet plus decisive-key sheet.

tango.basis: Shared offset-ready/query/deep-coil establishes asymmetrical anticipation. Variant A commits from LEFT support into low-right acceleration, a one-frame right catch, four-frame deep absorb, torso overshoot, one-frame support reacquire, and a new x29 right-biased ready. Variant B commits from RIGHT support with a slower loaded release into one-frame high-left whip, one-frame opposite catch, four-frame torsion hold, one-frame secondary-lag snapback, four-frame broad-support recovery debt, and a distinct x19 back-weighted ready. Branch timing and silhouettes are visibly nonuniform; support changes occur only at decisive keys; connective arcs do not cross support topology; neither branch reverse-interpolates or returns to the shared idle address.

noodle_queen.taste: The branch split has authored attitude rather than palette-bank bookkeeping: A is low/crossing/braking; B is high/whipping/torsional.
noodle_queen.function: The zero-time selection rule remains structurally true while the first body consequence after selection visibly commits different support owners, cadence, silhouettes, lag, and recovery.
noodle_queen.contempt: Not placeholder motion: the same precommit state yields two performances with different force stories and different final debt addresses.
